name: How long does it typically take to install a pool spillway?

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to install a pool spillway?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation timeframe for a pool spillway varies significantly based on its complexity, size, and whether it's part of a new pool construction or an existing pool renovation. For a new pool build, the spillway integration is typically part of the overall construction schedule, adding minimal time to the total project. For an existing pool, adding a spillway can take anywhere from a few days for a simple pre-fabricated unit to several weeks for a custom-designed, built-in feature requiring extensive plumbing and masonry work. We provide a detailed timeline after assessing your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time for a pool spillway depends on its complexity and if it's for a new or existing pool, ranging from a few days to several weeks.
